name: Jamaican Curry Chicken Recipe
assumptions: Yield estimated at 4 servings based on 2 lbs chicken plus potato and typical Jamaican curry chicken portion sizes (about 6-8 oz chicken per serving).
Total time is sum of minimums: 60 min marinate + 1 min curry bloom + 5 min saute + 35 min simmer (including last 15 min with potato).
All-purpose seasoning assumed free of wheat, soy, sesame as unspecified; conservative null for sesame.
Scotch bonnet and thyme treated as included despite 'if using' note.
No barley/rye/wheat ingredients present; recipe is gluten-free by ingredient screening.
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, or peanuts listed.
instructions:
Equipment

Dutch Oven

Instructions
 
Add chicken thighs, all-purpose seasoning, 1 tablespoon of curry powder, onion, green onions, green pepper, garlic cloves, scotch bonnet pepper (if using), and thyme to a large bowl and combine, making sure all chicken pieces are covered with the seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
One the chicken is done marinating, remove onions, peppers, and garlic cloves from chicken and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy bottom pot over medium heat. Add remaining curry powder and stir, cooking for about 20-30 seconds. Add onions, green pepper, garlic cloves, thyme, and scotch bonnet pepper (if using) to pot and stir until onions have softened, about 3-5 minutes. If your onions and peppers are looking dry, add about 1 tablespoon of water.
Add chicken and ¼ cup of water to the pot. Cover and reduce heat to medium low. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 30-35 minutes.
When there is about 15 minutes remaining, stir in potato and continue to cook covered.
Once chicken is cooked and potatoes are softened, remove from heat. Salt and pepper to taste.

ingredients.name: Chicken Thighs
ingredients.assumptions: 2 lbs bone-in skin-on chicken thighs; raw edible portion estimated at full weight as typical for recipe context

ingredients.name: Curry Powder
ingredients.assumptions: 2.5 tablespoons curry powder; standard density ~6 g/Tbsp, typical Jamaican blend

ingredients.name: All-purpose Seasoning
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp all-purpose seasoning; typical blend density ~5 g/tsp

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium chopped onion; ~110 g edible raw portion

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 3 chopped spring/green onions; ~15 g each edible raw portion

ingredients.name: Green Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 medium green bell pepper; ~60 g edible raw portion

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 4 chopped garlic cloves; ~3 g each, raw

ingredients.name: Scotch Bonnet
ingredients.assumptions: 1 chopped scotch bonnet pepper; typical small pepper ~10 g edible raw, assumed included despite 'if using'

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 3 sprigs fresh thyme; ~2 g per sprig, leaves and tender stem edible portion

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 3 tablespoons olive oil; standard 13.3 g per Tbsp

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 cup water plus 1 Tbsp as needed for saute; total estimated 60 g, contributes negligible macros

ingredients.name: Russet Potato
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large russet potato; ~300 g peeled edible raw portion, added late in cooking

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: Salt to taste; estimated 2 g typical usage, negligible macros

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: Pepper to taste; estimated 1 g typical usage, negligible macros
